caption: The drawing displays two technical views of a round object, likely a decorative button or brooch, on a plain beige background. The object is shown in a "front elevation" at the top center of the image, as a circular shape with a geometric, maze-like design inside that consists of interlocking lines and a central cross, depicted in shades of green, brown, and black. Directly below this, the "side elevation" is depicted with the object’s circular face on the right and a protruding pin or shank to the left, colored in muted beige and brown tones. Next to these views, at the lower right, handwritten text reads "SCALE TWICE ACTUAL SIZE," and below that, "R. ELVIS." The overall composition centers the drawings and text within the mostly empty space of the paper.
title: Earring
